messages:
jess: quick kickoff: Helios private deploy — need cross-team alignment on acceptance, security, infra. timeline: customer wants staging by 2024-11-15. who owns what?

mike: runtime: main blocker is quantized model binary for T4 pool. compiling + perf validation ~5 workdays. fallback to fp16 ok but ~2x cost.

ali: infra: to reserve dedicated pool in eu-west-1 need estimate of peak rps + batch sizing. ballpark numbers?

lee: solutions: Helios expects P95 gen latency <200ms for 2-token prompt + 512 gen. Also embedding job daily 30k vectors.

nina: cs: Helios legal signed data residency clause -> EU-only. audit log retention 12mo. Also SAML required.

sofia: security: need threat model + SCA by sec by Nov 1. also confirm KMS integration and key rotation policy. no exceptions.

mike: noted. rough perf estimate: with quantized kernel p95 ~140ms at 100rps on 4xA10s; fp16 ~220ms. I'll put numbers in perf doc.

jess: @ali we can aim for 120rps peak, 3x headroom (360) for safety. does that map to a dedicated pool?

ali: yes. 4xA10s pool with autoscale to 8 is doable. lead time for physical allocation ~7 days after commit. cost ok.

sofia: SAML + KMS: ops steps needed from infra to enable customer IdP SSO — @ali can you capture tasks?

ali: @sofia yes, I'll add task: 'enable IdP connector + KMS policy attach'. need Helios SP metadata.

lee: acceptance checklist draft: ```- P95 gen latency <=200ms
- Embedding throughput >=30k/day
- EU-only ingress/routes
- SAML SSO working
- Audit logs 12mo
- Rollback path to shared-hosted model```

jess: perfect. one more: rollback SLA requirement from Helios is 99.9% uptime during preview—product to scope canary.

mike: canary plan: staged rollout 10%->50%->100% with perf gates. If p95 >250ms or error rate >1% rollback.

nina: customer will run evals, ask for stable model version pinning and model-diff report before cutover.

jess: action items: 1) mike: perf validation + perf doc (due 10/25) 2) ali: capacity reservation + IdP/KMS task (due 10/28) 3) sofia: threat model + SCA signoff (due 11/1) 4) lee: finalize acceptance doc & test harness (due 10/30) 5) nina: get Helios SP metadata & retention legal (due 10/20). I'll own rollout cadence.

deploy-bot: Reminder: capacity-reservation ticket created #INC-8712 (assigned to ali), ETA 7 days

jess: closing — quick sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to confirm targets. :thumbsup:
